passages.title: A: Riverside Adventure Park
passages.text: This park offers thrilling zip-lines and high-rope courses through the trees. It is perfect for those who love an adrenaline rush and want to test their physical limits in a beautiful outdoor setting.

passages.title: B: The Historical Museum
passages.text: Explore ancient artifacts and learn about the city's origins. The museum features interactive displays that are great for families with children who want to learn while having fun.

passages.title: C: Coastal Art Gallery
passages.text: Located right by the sea, this gallery showcases local artists' work. It is a quiet, peaceful place to spend an afternoon admiring paintings and photography inspired by the ocean.

passages.title: D: Mountain Peak Trails
passages.text: If you enjoy long walks and breathtaking views, this is the place for you. Remember to bring sturdy boots and plenty of water, as the climb to the summit can be quite challenging.

passages.title: E: City Botanical Gardens
passages.text: A tranquil escape in the middle of the city. Walk through exotic flower displays and relax by the central fountain. It is an ideal spot for anyone looking for a calm, relaxing day out.

passages.title: F: Old Town Cooking School
passages.text: Learn to prepare traditional local dishes in a friendly group environment. This is a hands-on experience where you get to eat what you make at the end of the class.

passages.title: G: Science Discovery Center
passages.text: This center is packed with experiments and technology demonstrations. It is highly recommended for teenagers interested in engineering and how things work in the modern world.

passages.title: H: Lakeside Boat Rentals
passages.text: Rent a small rowing boat or a pedal boat for an hour or two. It is a fun way to get out on the water and enjoy the sunshine with friends or family.

questions.question: Sarah wants to do something active that will get her heart racing and test her fitness.
questions.explanation: Sarah wants an adrenaline rush and physical challenge, which matches the zip-lines and high-rope courses in A.

questions.question: Mark is looking for a peaceful place to enjoy art and look at the sea.
questions.explanation: Mark wants art and the sea, which is exactly what the Coastal Art Gallery offers.

questions.question: Elena wants to learn a new skill and enjoy a meal with other people.
questions.explanation: The cooking school provides a group environment to learn and eat, fitting Elena's needs.

questions.question: Tom is a teenager who loves technology and wants to see scientific experiments.
questions.explanation: The Science Discovery Center is recommended for teenagers interested in technology and experiments.

questions.question: Julia wants to spend a quiet, relaxing day surrounded by nature in the city.
questions.explanation: The Botanical Gardens offer a tranquil escape and a relaxing day out in the city.
